verdict.rationale: Inline completions are a fair axis for an AI coding product, so this story applies to Devin. The pack never mentions inline completions, tab-complete or next-edit suggestions. The closest item is Devin Desktop's vague mention of "AI-powered assistance" when coding, which does not show as-you-type completions. The rest of the evidence describes agentic, session-based work: tickets, the CLI agent, review and handoff.
